raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Fix FFN FLOPs and memory-traffic underestimation when dense/MoE layer counts are not divisible by pipeline parallel size.

## Claims

- Preserve fractional average-stage contributions for dense, routed and shared FFNs.
- Keep all breakdown outputs integer-valued.

## Validation

```sh
.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/v1/metrics/test_perf_metrics.py -q
# 75 passed

.venv/bin/pre-commit run --files vllm/v1/metrics/perf.py tests/v1/metrics/test_perf_metrics.py
# All applicable hooks passed
```

Three parameterized regression cases check contribution conservation and integer outputs. Additional CPU validation with four official model configs at PP=1/2/4 passed all 36 breakdown checks.

For [GLM-5.3](https://huggingface.co/zai-org/GLM-5.3/blob/ba32f8c19c8738e2c57c71798c601d477a7bf844/config.json), TP8/PP2 with four prefill tokens changes FFN FLOPs/device from 12,796,821,504 to the expected 13,079,937,024, fixing a 2.16% underestimate.

Validation covers estimator arithmetic on CPU. GPU serving was not tested; model-output evaluation is not applicable to this metrics-only change.

## Details

Flooring dense and MoE layer counts separately discards contributions: GLM-5.3 at PP=2 counts `1 dense + 37 MoE` instead of the average `1.5 dense + 37.5 MoE`. Retain fractional counts until final integer conversion, consistent with `AttentionMetrics` after #55624.

Duplicate checks on 2026-10-19 found no matching open fix. Related #54228 changes activated-expert estimation and #58836 adds linear-attention accounting; neither fixes FFN PP division.

AI assistance was used for this change and validation.

---

- [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans).
- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.
- [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI.
- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.

</details>

+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "metric_name",
+    [
+        "get_num_flops_breakdown",
+        "get_read_bytes_breakdown",
+        "get_write_bytes_breakdown",
+    ],
+)
+def test_ffn_pipeline_parallelism_preserves_mixed_layer_contributions(
+    metric_name,
+):
+    """Average stages retain dense and MoE contributions, including minority layers."""
+    hf_config = DeepseekV3Config(
+        hidden_size=8,
+        intermediate_size=16,
+        num_hidden_layers=6,
+        n_routed_experts=8,
+        num_experts_per_tok=2,
+        moe_intermediate_size=4,
+        n_shared_experts=1,
+        first_k_dense_replace=1,
+        moe_layer_freq=1,
+    )
+    vllm_config = create_mock_vllm_config(hf_config, pipeline_parallel_size=2)
+    metrics = FfnMetrics.from_vllm_config(vllm_config)
+    ctx = ExecutionContext.from_single_request(
+        num_tokens=4, context_len=8, is_prefill=True
+    )
+
+    breakdown = getattr(metrics, metric_name)
+    global_values = breakdown(ctx, per_gpu=False)
+    per_gpu_values = breakdown(ctx, per_gpu=True)
+
+    assert all(isinstance(value, int) for value in per_gpu_values.values())
+    assert {key: value * 2 for key, value in per_gpu_values.items()} == global_values
+
